lines.text: Show what you can do: build an app around an algorithm you understand deeply, and explain it in blocks and in Python.
A sorting visualiser that draws bars as it sorts.
A cipher app with brute-force cracking.
A contact finder with binary search.
Write your algorithm in plain steps first (pseudocode), then in blocks, then in Python.
Count the steps your algorithm takes for different inputs, and explain its efficiency.
Demo the app, walk through the algorithm, and show your Python version.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
